resources.string: Skip pairing on the local network

Off by default. When enabled, browsers directly connected to the same local network can manage this device without pairing. Access across networks still requires pairing. To block local access, turn this off.
Optional: one HTTP address per line, including the port used by your browser.
Enter the code on the browser login page. It is valid for five minutes and can be used once. Choose “Remember this browser” to stay paired for 30 days, including after restarts.
Authorization: %1$s\nRevoking this authorization also removes its remembered pairing. Local browsers can still sign in while local network access without pairing is enabled.
No browser is available to open this address.
Only this device can currently access WebUI.
Network discovery failed. Only the local entry is available; the service will check again.
Some addresses could not be opened. Check the port and network, then reload settings.
The result could not be confirmed. Reload saved settings before making another change.
Settings changed elsewhere. Reload them before saving again.
This native service does not support WebUI management. Use a build that includes WebUI.
Unable to read the service result. Check that the native service is running, then refresh.
Too many pairing codes or sessions. Wait a moment or sign out an unused browser, then refresh.
Enter up to eight HTTP addresses, one per line, without a path, query or credentials.
